core_aesthetic_takeaways: The batch is valuable because it carries the unique logic of Chinese university design competitions: topic research, methodology, cultural evidence, design practice, UI proof, and application scenarios in one board system.
Unlike commercial brand work, the visual goal is not immediate purchase or brand memorability; it is to prove a research proposition through organized evidence and cultural storytelling.
Teal academic framing, rounded white containers, dashed modules, illustrated maps, and repeated ship markers form a stable Culture China board grammar.
High density can be acceptable when section tags, module borders, and inset hierarchy preserve reading order.
The web board is useful for teaching how to present UI interaction inside a competition deliverable rather than designing a standalone commercial website.
prompt_structure_lessons: Start with project context: university discipline competition, Culture China, cultural tourism research, public cultural communication.
Name the board role before visual style: research overview board, web interaction board, detailed infovis board.
Separate title/header, project explanation, visualized evidence, interaction proof, and application display.
Describe illustrated maps and cultural icons by function, not as loose decoration.
For dense Chinese body copy, request verified source text or use clean placeholder text blocks.

safe_exact_text_candidates: 数智技术赋能天津城市“文化旅游”共情体验设计研究
Empathic Experience Design for Cultural Tourism in Tianjin City Empowered by Digital-Intelligent Technologies
text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use the batch for academic board logic, cultural tourism infovis, and UI proof hierarchy. Do not train watermark text or dense copy as exact typography targets.

risk_controls.risk: mixing academic competition boards with commercial brand prompts
risk_controls.mitigation: Require project_context_ids and keep commercial-project fit low unless the user explicitly asks for commercial adaptation.
Mark watermark_contamination in captions; exclude diagonal gray watermark from positive prompt atoms.
Treat micro-labels and long body copy as placeholder blocks unless source text is provided.
Keep large boards, screenshot grids, and illustration clusters inside named modules with visible margins.
Tie each cultural symbol to route, timeline, food, landmark, river, web interaction, or application proof.

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: include as a Culture China / academic competition exhibition-board positive case after rights review
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: use captions to teach research-led board sequence, cultural tourism infovis, and UI interaction proof
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: train as a separate academic-discipline-competition subset before mixing with commercial VI or packaging cases

negative_prompt_atoms: random cultural icons without research logic
decorative teal background without academic hierarchy
